add_schedule.title: Add schedule
add_schedule.description: Select the type of schedule to create

configure_date.title: Configure date schedule
configure_date.description:
Create a schedule based on specific dates (e.g., March 15 to June 20)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

configure_week.title: Configure week schedule
configure_week.description:
Create a schedule based on week of month (e.g., First Monday of March to Last Friday of June)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

configure_nth_day.title: Configure nth day schedule
configure_nth_day.description:
Create a schedule based on nth occurrence of a weekday (e.g., Second Tuesday of March, 2 days before to 3 days after)

Note: To clear the configuration field, enter a single space character.

data_description.configuration: Optional YAML configuration for this schedule. To clear, enter a single space.

remove_schedule.title: Remove schedule
remove_schedule.description: Are you sure you want to remove '{schedule_name}' ({schedule_type})?

default_configuration.title: Default configuration
default_configuration.description: Set the default YAML configuration for all schedules. This will be used when a schedule doesn't have its own configuration.

abort.no_schedules: No schedules to edit or remove
